situations.title: 두부외상 초기 사정
situations.tagline: I hit my head when I fell—I think I blacked out for a second.
situations.brief: 기전·의식소실·건망 여부를 확인해 두부외상을 초기 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: How did you hit your head?
Did you lose consciousness at all?
Do you remember everything right before it happened?

situations.title: GCS 측정·재평가
situations.tagline: I'm a bit fuzzy, but I can hear you okay.
situations.brief: 초기 GCS를 기록하고 추세를 재평가하세요.
keyPhrases: Can you open your eyes and look at me?
Tell me where you are and what day it is.
I'm going to recheck this in a few minutes.

situations.title: 동공 반응 확인
situations.tagline: The light is so bright—is something wrong with my eyes?
situations.brief: 동공의 크기·대칭·빛반응을 확인해 신경학적 이상을 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm shining a light in your eyes—look straight ahead.
This checks how your pupils respond.
It'll only take a second, hold still.

situations.title: 두피 열상·혈종 관찰
situations.tagline: There's a big bump on my head and it's bleeding a little.
situations.brief: 두피 열상·혈종을 촉진하고 압박지혈하며 관찰하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm going to gently feel your scalp.
We'll apply pressure to stop the bleeding.
Tell me if any spot is especially painful.

situations.title: 오심·구토 모니터
situations.tagline: I feel really nauseous and I just threw up once.
situations.brief: 오심·구토를 뇌압 상승 징후로 보고 모니터링하세요.
keyPhrases: How many times have you vomited?
Is the nausea getting worse?
We're watching for signs of pressure in your head.

situations.title: 경증 뇌진탕 귀가교육
situations.tagline: So I can go home? What should I watch out for?
situations.brief: 관찰 징후와 재내원 기준을 설명하며 경증 뇌진탕 귀가교육을 하세요.
keyPhrases: Come back if you have worsening headache or vomiting.
Watch for confusion, drowsiness, or weakness.
Have someone stay with you tonight.

situations.title: 항응고제 복용 경미 두부외상
situations.tagline: I just bumped my head, but I'm on a blood thinner—should I worry?
situations.brief: 지연 출혈 위험을 사정하고 CT 필요성을 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: Which blood thinner are you taking?
Even a minor bump can bleed slowly in the brain.
We recommend a CT scan to be safe.
goals: 항응고제 복용과 지연 출혈 위험을 사정한다

situations.title: 고령 낙상 경막하 의심
situations.tagline: Dad's been more confused since he fell last week—is that normal?
situations.brief: 서서히 진행·지연 발현하는 경막하 출혈을 의심해 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: When exactly did he fall?
Has his confusion been getting worse over days?
A slow brain bleed can show up like this.

situations.title: 소아 두부외상 부모 소통
situations.tagline: He fell off the couch—he cried but seems okay now, right?
situations.brief: 학대를 감별하고 관찰 지표를 설명하며 소아 두부외상 부모와 소통하세요.
keyPhrases: Can you walk me through exactly how he fell?
Watch for vomiting, unusual sleepiness, or fussiness.
We'll examine him carefully to be sure.

situations.title: 음주 동반 두부외상
situations.tagline: I'm fine, just had a few drinks... I don't need any scan.
situations.brief: 취기와 손상을 감별하고 관찰의 필요성을 설득하세요.
keyPhrases: How much did you drink tonight?
I can't tell if it's alcohol or your injury—so we watch you.
Please stay so we can recheck you.

situations.title: 두개저 골절 징후
situations.tagline: I've got bruising around both eyes and fluid dripping from my nose.
situations.brief: 너구리눈·battle sign·이루 등 두개저 골절 징후를 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: I see bruising around your eyes—when did that appear?
Is there any clear fluid from your nose or ears?
Please don't blow your nose.

situations.title: 뇌진탕후증후군
situations.tagline: It's been two weeks and I still get headaches and dizziness.
situations.brief: 지속되는 두통·어지럼 등 뇌진탕후증후군을 사정하고 교육하세요.
keyPhrases: How long have the headaches been going on?
Any trouble concentrating or sleeping?
These symptoms can linger after a concussion.

situations.title: 반복 구토·기면 진행
situations.tagline: He keeps throwing up and now he's so hard to wake up.
situations.brief: 반복 구토·기면 진행을 뇌압 상승으로 보고 재평가하세요.
keyPhrases: How many times has he vomited now?
Is he getting harder to wake up?
This could mean rising pressure—we're rechecking him now.

situations.title: 언어장벽 두부외상
situations.tagline: Head... hit. Sleep medicine... yes. Blood thinner... yes.
situations.brief: 언어장벽 환자에서 의식소실·항응고 여부를 통역과 몸짓으로 확보하세요.
keyPhrases: Did you black out? Yes or no?
Blood thinner medicine—do you take it?
I'm getting an interpreter for you.

situations.title: 경막외혈종 명료기 후 악화
situations.tagline: I felt totally fine a minute ago—now my head is exploding...
situations.brief: 명료기 후 급격한 악화(lucid interval)를 인지하고 응급 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Your headache is suddenly much worse—we're acting now.
Stay with me and keep talking to me.
We're calling neurosurgery immediately.

situations.title: 뇌탈출 임박(동공 산대)
situations.tagline: *one pupil blown, decerebrate posturing*
situations.brief: 동공 산대·자세이상을 뇌탈출 임박으로 인지하고 응급 감압을 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: One pupil is blown—this is an emergency.
We're hyperventilating and giving medication to reduce pressure.
Neurosurgery is coming for emergency decompression.

situations.title: 두부외상 삽관·환기
situations.tagline: *GCS 6, requires airway protection*
situations.brief: 기도 보호와 뇌압 조절 균형을 고려하며 두부외상 환자의 삽관·환기를 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: GCS is 6—we need to secure the airway.
Maintain oxygenation and avoid rises in pressure.
Target normal CO2 to protect the brain.

situations.title: 관통성 두부손상
situations.tagline: There's something embedded in my head—please don't touch it!
situations.brief: 박힌 물체를 고정하고 신경외과 이송을 조율하며 관통성 두부손상을 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: We're stabilizing the object and leaving it in place.
Please keep your head as still as possible.
Neurosurgery is on the way for you.

situations.title: 두부외상 SBAR 인계
situations.tagline: Head trauma handoff—GCS trend, pupils, and anticoagulation.
situations.brief: GCS·동공·항응고 정보를 SBAR로 정리해 두부외상 환자를 인계하세요.
keyPhrases: GCS dropped from 14 to 10 over 30 minutes.
Right pupil is now sluggish and dilated.
He's on apixaban; reversal is being considered.
goals: GCS 추세와 동공 변화를 명확히 인계한다

situations.title: 외상성 발작 동반
situations.tagline: *seizing after head injury, GCS declining*
situations.brief: 발작과 뇌압 상승이 동시에 진행되는 외상성 발작에 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: We're giving medication to stop the seizure now.
Protecting the airway and giving oxygen.
Watching closely for rising brain pressure.
